descriptionChirho: The proper name Oreb, referring to one of two Midianite princes captured and executed by the Ephraimites during Gideon's campaign (Judg 7:25, 8:3), and also to the rock where he was slain, subsequently named after him (Judg 7:25, Isa 10:26). Multilingual evidence: eng 'Oreb/like Oreb,' spa 'Orev/Oreb/como Orev,' hin 'oreb ko/oreb kii tarah,' arb 'uwriyb/ka-uwrayba,' kor 'oret/oret cheoreom,' swa 'Orebu/kama Orebu.' The prepositional prefix form (ke- + Oreb, 'like Oreb') is a syntactic comparison, not a different sense of the name.
